scope.qa_sort: lexicographic tuples; strings lexical, integer dimensions numerical ascending
scope.weighting: paired strategy difference per case, equal heldout combination and noise weights, within-seed DiD, then equal fixed-seed mean

metric_operator: Exact original _PreparedAUC AST class only; stable sorting, exact ties, half-credit tie U statistic; arithmetic macro over all five classes, NaN propagates
weighting: At each matched combo/noise case first subtract train strategies per test structure; equal average over 10 combos x 5 noise bases; within fixed seed difference across tests; equal average across five fixed seeds
uncertainty: ddof=1 training seed SD separate from 2.5/97.5 common-patient percentile CI; checkpoints and noise fixed; no new hypothesis tests

identity_rules.common: identical ordered IDs, patients, indices, labels, classes, clean tensor identity, config and draw map
identity_rules.within_test: same whole-case and derived per-record final normalized float32 noisy input across training strategies
identity_rules.within_training: same checkpoint across test structures; strategy checkpoints must differ
identity_rules.record_hashes: Diagnostics contain no record hashes. Reconstruct immutable float32 cache; verify whole tensor hash before deriving normalized raw-byte record hashes; no waveform output

schema.four_arm_alignment: one selected prediction per row; 4000 rows
schema.record_input_identity: one row per input case/record, independent of strategy/model/seed; 200 x 2158 rows
schema.did_draw_audit: all 2000 draws x (5 seeds + aggregate seed=-1) x 4 architecture/SNR groups, including NaNs and valid flag
